profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Gabriel Garcia is a highly accomplished professional currently exploring fields of software development, autonomous systems and information technology.

positions.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Node.js · System Performance · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Angular · System Performance · Django REST Framework · Python (Programming Language) · Project Management · Apache Pulsar · TypeScript

positions.title: Student Technology Assistant Resource
positions.description: At PLNU, professors use a program called Canvas to post grades, assignments and course content for students. My responsibilities were to support professors with Canvas via phone, email, video messaging and face-to-face meetings. In addition, I developed and taught lessons to professors on useful student technologies.

positions.title: Summer Researcher
positions.description: Built an iOS app and Node.js backend in Google Cloud. The application allowed users to verify event attendance using their current location.

positions.title: Photo Booth Attendant
positions.description: My responsibilities include setting up, programming and maintaining operation of photo booths for weddings, parties and corporate events while using customer service skills to keep clients and guests informed and satisfied.

volunteerExperiences.description: Every Thursday I spent a few hours tutoring, mentoring and inspiring high school students to work hard in school. At Reality Changers our goal was to prepare students for college while building meaningful relationships with them.
